# Development card only: direct firmware boot, no U-Boot/A/B yet.
start_file=start4.elf
fixup_file=fixup4.dat
kernel=Image
arm_64bit=1
disable_overscan=1
disable_splash=1
boot_delay=0
# Avoid firmware's default HDMI-A-1/60 Hz modeset before the KMS splash.
# KMS selects the configured connector/mode from satip-config.txt and data.
disable_fw_kms_setup=1
avoid_warnings=2
enable_uart=1
# Last-resort hardware reset if the watchdog feeder stops running.
dtparam=watchdog=on
# Dedicate PL011 on GPIO14/15 to recovery; Bluetooth is outside SAT-IP scope.
dtoverlay=disable-bt
dtoverlay=vc4-kms-v3d
# Reference GPIO23 receiver; packaged learned map is specific to observed remote ID.
dtoverlay=gpio-ir,gpio_pin=23,rc-map-name=rc-empty
